'''M'Hanna''' was a desolate [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[M'Hanna system/Legends|M'Hanna system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet was connected to the worlds of [[Tisht]] and [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[the Dead Road]],<ref name="TEA" /> while the [[Elgit–M'Hanna Corridor]] linked M'Hanna to the planet of [[Sakifwanna]].<ref name="LoNH" /> M'Hanna was a world of [[Color/Legends|black]] dust that was scoured by supersonic winds, and its history was the subject of various rumors and legends.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
M'Hanna was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square T-11.<ref name="TEA" />
